rule.checkpoint: max macro-average AP over the two source validation sets, subject to AP > prevalence on both
rule.threshold: single global final-logit threshold maximising the equally weighted mean of the two per-source pooled full-grid binary IoUs
rule.forbidden: KITTI-360 data, labels, prevalence, metrics or predictions play no part in any of the above

binarization_agreement.cause: float32 bin-edge precision in the score histogram (~1.9e-6 near the +16 offset); scores within one ULP below tau bin as >= tau

selection_criterion.checkpoint: max macro-average AP over the two source validation sets, subject to AP > prevalence on both
selection_criterion.threshold: single global final-logit threshold maximising the equally weighted mean of the two per-source pooled full-grid binary IoUs
selection_criterion.forbidden: KITTI-360 data, labels, prevalence, metrics or predictions play no part in any of the above
